sloka: आजग्मुस्ते ऽपि हरयो रामदर्शनकांक्षिणः ।अङ्गदं पुरतः कृत्वा हनूमन्तं च वानरम् ।। ५.६४.३५ ।।।।
transliteration: ājagmuste 'pi harayo rāmadarśanakāṁkṣiṇaḥ ।aṅgadaṁ purataḥ kṛtvā hanūmantaṁ ca vānaram ।। 5.64.35 ।।।।

translations.english: The joyful monkeys with Angada and Hanuman leading them descended with eagerness to have a close look at Rama.
